title: В + accusative: On Tuesday, on Wednesday: the days of the week

blocks.text: В + Accusative is used to indicate the time of the day, the day of the week, and how frequently something occurs.

items.head: В + Accusative is used:
points: to indicate the time of the day
to indicate the day of the week
to indicate how frequently something occurs

items.text: Units smaller than a week (day, hour etc.) take „В + Acc.“

blocks.text: DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 19 and 73. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.

exercises.q: Уроки возобновятся в ___ (понедельник, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **понедельник → понедельник** (acc. sg.). В + accusative: the time of day, the day of the week, or how often. Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом. Accusative = nominative.

exercises.q: Вы в ___ (пятница, acc. sg.) свободны?
exercises.why: **пятница → пятницу** (acc. sg.). В + accusative: the time of day, the day of the week, or how often. Feminine. Declines like газета. Ending -а → -у.

exercises.q: Мой шурин умер в ___ (прошлая среда, acc. sg.).

exercises.why: **среда → среду** (acc. sg.). В + accusative: the time of day, the day of the week, or how often. Feminine. Declines like газета. Ending -а → -у.  **прошлый → прошлую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with среду). Declines like новый. Ending -ая → -ую.
